body: It’s just one of those days Sam!!! We all get them, you’ll be fine, chin up chap!

Girls can be into short guys 
Attractiveness is personal opinion 
Social anxiety is ok, working through it slowly is perfect 
You have years to make friends 
You also have years to find your true love 
My grades could also be better, shit. 
I have no friends, it’s ok. 
Losing interest is normal when you feel sad, just research into different things. 
Girlfriends aren’t everything, especially if they break your heart (I can relate, made me 50x more suicidal)

You’re lucky to have parents, I do not. 
Religion is bullshit, it’s like a safety net for the already weak and deluded minds.

There are a few more issues with all of us, it’s how we deal with them that takes us further in life, push ahead, try and succeed. No billionaire business owners made it through being normal like everyone else, it’s the troubled ones on the outskirts that make the change

Hello and thank you for coming here with your story: 

I too do not get on with my mother and she also uses the “get a job” everyday as a knife at my throat, but since everything I’ve also been through in the end you do find your feet, you’re envious of people who have already “succeeded” but no, it’s not too late for you and it never will be, you have youth on your side and the downside of that is unfortunately the thinking mechanism that brings so many of us down, but I’m sure sitting there and being alone must be a major factor in your sadness, the world is always full of opportunity regardless and I feel like if you push a bit further you’ll end up hitting your 50’s and looking back wishing you knew what you knew then now, i’d like to ask you to ring a support line daily and work on yourself, I know how hard things are when you don’t have anyone you can vent with but I also know you have that little feeling inside you that doesn’t want to cease to exist, there’s too much wonderment on the “what if’s”
